Who we are: 
 Do you want to join a well-established bank with a start-up culture? No, we’re not joking!
 We, at tbi , have been one the most profitable banks for years and we are growing at a fast pace. We’re a bank with a long history of success that operates as a start-up and we’re always on the lookout for new opportunities to grow our business. How do we do that?
 It's all about our people . Our team is made up of brave, passionate and caring people who don’t just want to follow the same path – we want to transform into mobile-first, state-of-the-art lifestyle ecosystem. Our colleagues love working here – 80% of them would recommend tbi as an employer to their friends and family. Our people are engaged in challenging and meaningful work, inspired to grow their potential and career, encouraged to learn and empowered to take decisions. That’s not corporate babble, it’s what our people say.
 Do you want to play a key role in our unique success story? If so, we’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join us on the journey to success.
 What You’ll do: 
 Turn data into insights: Analyze financial data to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations that support business decisions.
 Understand business needs: Collaborate with key stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications and practical solutions.
 Drive process improvements: Evaluate existing financial processes and systems, identify inefficiencies, and implement solutions to optimize workflows, reduce costs, and improve performance.
 Create impactful reports: Develop reports, dashboards, and presentations that turn complex financial information into clear insights for management and key stakeholders.
 Support financial transformation: Actively contribute to strategic transformation initiatives and cross-functional projects, helping drive meaningful organizational change.
 Monitor and improve performance: Track the effectiveness of implemented solutions, measure results, and recommend adjustments to ensure continuous improvement.
 Ensure compliance and best practices: Support alignment with financial regulations, internal policies, and industry best practices while exploring new technologies and innovative solutions.
 Collaborate across teams: Work closely with different departments, providing guidance and ensuring alignment with financial transformation objectives.
 Make an impact: Proactively identify opportunities to enhance financial operations, improve decision-making, and contribute to the company's long-term success.
 What you’ll need to succeed: 
 Strong analytical skills: Experience in financial data analysis, identifying trends, interpreting complex information, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
 Business analysis experience: Proven ability to gather business requirements, document functional specifications, and translate business needs into practical solutions.
 Financial process knowledge: Good understanding of financial processes, reporting, and opportunities for operational improvement.
 Process optimization mindset: Experience identifying inefficiencies, streamlining workflows, and implementing solutions that improve efficiency and reduce costs.
 Reporting and visualization skills: Proficiency in Excel and experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
 Project and change management: Ability to support financial transformation initiatives, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to successful project delivery.
 Problem-solving approach: Strong critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
 Stakeholder management: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
 Business-oriented thinking: Ability to connect financial insights with business objectives and support data-driven decision-making.
 Educational background: University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
 English proficiency: Good command of English, both written and spoken, in an international business environment.
 Nice to Have: 
Previous experience in banking, financial services, or a multinational environment.
Familiarity with ERP systems, financial transformation projects, or automation initiatives.
Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, or other business intelligence and data analysis tools.
Experience working in Agile environments or with process improvement methodologies.
 What we offer: 
Seize the opportunity to grow your career.
Engage in exciting and meaningful work.
Get recognition for your work and attitude.
Become part of a large, friendly and supportive team.
Get additional private health insurance.
Stay Chill, Bite into Thrill: Our Fresh Fruits/Ice Cream Program.

Benefit from 28 days of annual leave – More time for what you love ( 22 vacation days, 5 for exceptional sick leave (no medical note), and 1 for your birthday ).
Exclusive partner discounts – Enjoy deals tailored just for you.
A World of Friendly Faces: Join Our Passionate Multinational Team and Talk to 16+ Nationalities at tbi bank .
Bring Your Furry Bestie: Let's Make Work Pawsome .
